name: Open Selected Container Tab
description: Opens any tab or URL in a selected Firefox container. After configuration, it opens any tab in the selected container even when a link is opened outside Firefox. Can also open a tab in a specific container by using the shortcut.
author: Ouro17

_execute_action.description: Open the popup for opening a new tab in the searched container.

open-fixed-container-tab.description: Open a new tab in the selected container
